I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. X and Bluesky fail, and LinkedIn passes.

- **X — FAIL:** the copy is one paragraph, and X needs at least two.
- **Bluesky — FAIL:** the copy is one paragraph, and Bluesky needs two.
- **LinkedIn — PASS:** it has three advisory notes (none of them block). The bullets lay out most of the article's mechanism, the opening question is generic, and the closing "Read how it works and grab the code." is a marketing-style pointer.

The suggested fix for X and Bluesky is to put "Open source today." in its own paragraph and leave the rest as written. That brings X to 238 of 255 characters and Bluesky to 219 of 300. A critique sub-agent passed both repaired drafts.

I left out the "missing pointer" note because it doesn't apply. The review has the required marker line, the `[!NOTE]` line, the collapsed `<details>` sections, and the footer. It also ends with the two CTA comment lines from SKILL.md's CI section (apply suggestions, re-run with `/social-review`), which your task didn't mention. Nothing was posted to the PR.
